subject: ACE registration & PDM/PSM intro — NimbusWorks (NW-2028-0415)
messages:
From: Sarah Patel <sarah@nimbusworks.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: AWS Partner Manager <pm@amazon.com>, procurement@nimbusworks.com
Date: 2028-04-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: ACE registration inquiry + PDM/PSM intro for NimbusWorks

Hi Mina,

Per our conversation with the AWS partner team last week, NimbusWorks is pursuing an AWS co-sell engagement for our new vector search product. We have a near-term pilot opportunity (~$150k ARR expected first 12 months) and AWS asked that we complete ACE registration so Redwood can be listed and eligible for co-sell.

Quick summary:
- Customer: NimbusWorks (health-tech analytics)
- Use case: privacy-preserving search across patient notes (embedding + reranking)
- Expected go-live: Q3 2028 pilot, broader rollouts in Q4

What we need from Redwood:
1) ACE registration assistance (intake, required artifacts)
2) Intro to the PDM/PSM to align on co-sell plan and next steps
3) A mutual-action plan template we can sign (or a DocuSign link)

I've attached an intake checklist and a short deck. Procurement is looped on this thread for contract timing. AWS PM (cc'd) will run the ACE intake once you confirm the contact.

Could we get a short intro call this week or early next? Our availability: Tue/Wed 10–12 PT, Thu 14–17 PT.

Thanks — happy to jump on whatever works.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | NimbusWorks
attachments: nimbus-ace-registration-form.pdf, nimbus-oppty-overview.pdf

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah@nimbusworks.com>

Subject: Re: ACE registration inquiry + PDM/PSM intro for NimbusWorks

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear summary and for looping us in.

We're excited to help NimbusWorks through ACE registration and to align on the pilot. Looping in Laura Bennett (PDM) and Aditya Rao (PSM) from our team to coordinate the co-sell plan and intake.

Proposed next steps:
- Quick sync (30m) to review intake artifacts and confirm timelines
- AWS intake submission by PM once we confirm the contact details and artifacts
- Draft mutual-action plan so procurement and your team can review (I'll send a DocuSign link)

Our availability matches yours: Wed 10:30–11:30 PT or Thu 15:00–16:00 PT. Which works?

Laura/Aditya — can you review the attached checklist from Nimbus and confirm any additional artifacts we should prepare (security questionnaire, SOC2 evidence, allowed data flows, expected tokens per month)?

Thanks — I'll prepare an initial MAP template and a short agenda for the call.

— Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Executive | Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0189

Date: 2028-04-15T12:20:00-07:00
Subject: RE: ACE registration inquiry + PDM/PSM intro for NimbusWorks

Thanks Sarah and Mina — happy to facilitate.

I can run the ACE intake as soon as Redwood confirms the primary contact and uploads the intake form (PDF) into the ACE portal. Please use the intake link below and include:
- AWS Partner Manager (pm@amazon.com) in the submission
- High-level go-to-market plan and any collateral that shows customer references

Intake link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/ace/intake/12345

I can join the sync on Thu 15:00 PT. Once intake is approved you'll get an ACE case number (we'll add that to the MAP).

— APM (AWS Partner Manager)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.inference.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.inference.com
Date: 2028-04-16T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: RE: ACE registration inquiry + PDM/PSM intro for NimbusWorks

Thanks for looping me in. A few notes from the PDM perspective before we meet:

1) Intake docs — we'll need a short architecture diagram (how embeddings are created and stored), expected token volume, and confirmation on whether any PHI will be processed. If PHI is involved, we need to confirm customer BAA or show how data is tokenized/hashed at source.

2) Co-sell motions — recommend we define three milestones in the MAP: Pilot start (integration + validation), Pilot success criteria (performance, precision/recall), and GA readiness (SLA and pricing commitments).

3) Resources — I can take the first two MAP checkpoints; Aditya can lead the customer enablement runbook for onboarding.

I've attached a draft MAP (mutual-action-plan-nimbus-v1.xlsx) and a short product checklist. I'll be on Thu 15:00 PT.

Laura Bennett
Product Director (PDM) | Redwood Inference
attachments: mutual-action-plan-nimbus-v1.xlsx, product-onboarding-checklist.pdf

Hi all — great sync earlier. Per our call:

- AWS intake has been submitted (see intake link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/ace/intake/12345).
- AWS PM confirmed they'll assign an ACE case number within 48 hours.
- Attached MAP (v1) sent via DocuSign for NimbusWorks procurement to review & sign: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=ef3b2a
- Action items:
  1) NimbusWorks: upload architecture diagram + token estimates to the intake portal by Fri 4/20
  2) Redwood (Aditya): prepare onboarding runbook and POA (priority)
  3) Laura: finalize pilot success criteria and SLA ask by Tue 4/23

Sarah / procurement — let me know if DocuSign needs any company-specific fields prefilled; otherwise the MAP link should route to procurement for signing. We'll wait for the ACE case number and then add it to the MAP.

Thanks — looking forward to getting NimbusWorks onto the ACE list.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Executive | Redwood Inference
